kicker: For the seat you don't feel worthy of
truth: You keep bracing to be sent away, but the door stayed open.
prayer: Lord, some part of me still expects to be found out and sent away. Thank You for pulling a chair out for me anyway, scars and shame and all. Teach me to sit down and stay. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness.

save: Save this for the fear of being sent away
